home.hero.subtitle: A strategic proposal for premium, accessible, and sustainable physiotherapy care in Bangladesh.
overview.title: Executive Overview
overview.intro: Motion Mechanics introduces FlexTime™, a modern framework for high-quality, sustainable care. Our system integrates five core pillars:
overview.pillar.operations.title: Multi-Shift Operations
overview.pillar.operations.desc: Structured shifts (Z, A, B, C), including the Nightfall FlexLab™, to expand access for all patient schedules.
overview.pillar.session.title: Diversified Session Model
overview.pillar.session.desc: A four-tier session model (Foundation, Standard, Premium, Express) aligned with clinical value and patient needs.
overview.pillar.staffing.title: Scalable Tiered Staffing
overview.pillar.staffing.desc: An interactive 5-tier staffing model that balances payroll costs with service capacity and future growth.
overview.pillar.carebridge.title: CareBridge™ Program
overview.pillar.carebridge.desc: A compassionate, subsidized program to ensure equitable care is woven into our sustainable model.
overview.pillar.financials.title: Data-Driven Financials
overview.pillar.financials.desc: Interactive models for staffing tiers, occupancy rates, and launch projections provide a clear, dynamic financial backbone for decision-making.
model.title: FlexTime™ Service Model
model.shift.z.desc: Early morning block for dedicated professionals and pre-work/school sessions.
model.shift.flexstart.title: FlexStart
model.shift.flexstart.desc: Internal staff preparation, calibration, and emergency early-day cases.
model.shift.a.title: FlexShift A
model.shift.a.desc: Morning care block emphasizing Neuro and Pediatric cases.
model.shift.midday_reset.title: Midday Reset
model.shift.midday_reset.desc: Buffer for turnover, sanitization, and staff reset between morning and afternoon blocks.
model.shift.b.title: FlexShift B
model.shift.b.desc: Afternoon block for evaluations, long-duration cases, and clinical training.
model.shift.commute_gap.title: Commute Gap
model.shift.commute_gap.desc: Buffer for staff travel and deconfliction to reduce congestion and improve safety.
model.shift.c.title: FlexShift C
model.shift.c.desc: Evening block for office-goers and acute pain. Includes the Nightfall FlexLab™.
model.shift.o.desc: Night shift operations for future or interplanetary operations — Purrfect Software Limited, Motion Mechanics online services, and more.

staffing.title: Interactive Staffing Tier Modeler
staffing.description: Use this slider to see how payroll, revenue, and service capacity scale with each staffing tier.
staffing.howto.title: How to use this model:
staffing.howto.items: 1) Select a staffing tier below to set your team size and payroll baseline. 2) Scroll to the Capacity Modeler to adjust occupancy and see revenue projections. 3) Explore Launch Models and CareBridge™ to understand how discounts and subsidized care affect profitability.
staffing.tier.0.name: Minimum Viable Opening Team
staffing.tier.1.name: Stable Launch Team
staffing.tier.2.name: Baseline Full Operations
staffing.tier.3.name: Expanded Operations & Early Mornings
staffing.tier.4.name: Full Ecosystem (Weekends + Home Care)
staffing.capacity.title: Capacity Overview
staffing.coverage.title: Service Coverage:
staffing.services.title: Services Unlocked at
staffing.services.tier.0.html:
MM Professional Extensions:
  • Basic Shifts A, B, C operational
  • Core Neuro, MSK, & Peds services
  • Standard ~50% bed capacity
PU Radical Innovations:
  • Nightfall FlexLab™ (Express) active
  • Limited redundancy; "all-hands" culture
staffing.services.tier.1.html:
MM Professional Extensions:
  • Stable 50-60% bed capacity
  • Stronger coverage for Shift C (Evening)
  • Improved staff leave/emergency coverage
PU Radical Innovations:
  • Dedicated Floater Staff introduced
  • Cross-departmental training begins
staffing.services.tier.2.html:
MM Professional Extensions:
  • Full FlexTime™ Model operational
  • All 7 beds fully staffed & active
  • Dedicated Rehab Gym support
PU Radical Innovations:
  • CareBridge™ Program fully launched
  • Robust Floater System (2 staff) for quality control & redundancy
staffing.services.tier.3.html:
MM Professional Extensions:
  • Partial Weekend operations (Sat)
  • Basic Home Care services initiated
  • Full staffing for all core shifts
PU Radical Innovations:
  • Radical FlexShift Z (06:00-09:00) unlocked
  • Targeted service for early-bird professionals
staffing.services.tier.4.html:
MM Professional Extensions:
  • Full Weekend operations (Sat/Sun)
  • Dedicated Home Care / On-call team
  • Expanded corporate wellness programs
PU Radical Innovations:
  • Full FlexShift Z integration
  • 24/7 On-Call service potential
  • Advanced Floater Team (3+) for R&D and training
staffing.financials.title: Tier Financials (at Assumed Occupancy)
staffing.financials.tooltip: Expected Revenue is modeled using full-price sessions at 22 working days/month and the assumed occupancy for this tier.
payroll.title: Dynamic Payroll Framework
payroll.description: This table is linked to the Staffing Tier Modeler. Change the tier to see a detailed payroll breakdown.
capacity.title: Dynamic Capacity Modeler
capacity.description: Select a Staffing Tier above to set your payroll cost. Then, use the slider below to model how Total Capacity Utilization (including over-capacity, on-call, and hybrid services) impacts your finances.
capacity.occupancy.label: Total Capacity Utilization:
capacity.occupancy.lock_note_restored: Locked — occupancy was restored from your previous session and locked to preserve your selection. Toggle to unlock.
capacity.occupancy.lock_note_saved: Locked — occupancy will not change when switching tiers. This setting is saved and will persist across refreshes.
capacity.occupancy.lock_note_unlocked: Unlocked — occupancy resets to this tier's default capacity when switching tiers.
capacity.warning.title: Above recommended capacity:
capacity.warning.desc: You are operating above the designed capacity for the current staffing tier. Consider increasing staffing or managing patient load.

pricing.legend.foundation.desc: First visit, assessment and comprehensive care
pricing.legend.standard.label: Standard:

launch.title: First-Year Launch Projection Models
launch.description: These are scenario-based projections for the first year of operations. Model A uses your selected staffing tier with varying discounts. Model B shows a fixed ramp-up path independent of the tier slider.
launch.model_a.title: Model A: Discounted Launch
launch.model_a.tier_label: Uses payroll from Tier {tier} (dynamically linked to slider)
launch.model_a.tooltip: Model A shows a fixed-staffing scenario using your currently selected tier. It varies only the discount rate over time while maintaining 60% occupancy throughout the year.
launch.model_b.title: Model B: Ramp-Up Scenario
launch.model_b.tier_label: Staffing grows Tier 0 → Tier 1 → Tier 2 (fixed, not linked to slider)
launch.model_b.tooltip: Model B shows a realistic growth path with both occupancy and staffing ramping up over time. This model is independent of your tier slider selection and always uses Tier 0→1→2.
launch.model_b.subtitle: (After initial ramp-up)
future.title: Year 2+ Dynamic Projections
future.description: These projections are fully dynamic. They are based on the Tier {tier} staffing model and a sustained {occupancy}% Capacity.
carebridge.title: CareBridge™ Program
carebridge.description: A structured, sustainable system for ensuring care accessibility is a core pillar of our mission.
carebridge.pillar1.title: Daily Subsidized Slots
carebridge.pillar1.desc: 8 sessions/day (~9% of total capacity) are reserved for the CareBridge™ program.
carebridge.pillar2.title: Discount Value
carebridge.pillar2.desc: A 30% discount is applied to Standard Sessions for all eligible beneficiaries.
carebridge.pillar3.title: Eligible Beneficiaries
carebridge.pillar4.title: Financial Impact
carebridge.pillar4.desc: Represents ~1.3 million BDT/year in subsidized care. The business remains highly profitable at all modeled occupancy levels.
carebridge.pillar5.title: Purpose and Brand Value
carebridge.pillar5.desc: Ensures equitable access to premium care, reinforces our social responsibility, and builds deep, lasting community trust and brand loyalty.

data.revenue_streams.title: Expanded Revenue Streams (Tier 3 & 4)
data.revenue_streams.tier3.title: Tier 3 (Partial Weekend)
data.revenue_streams.tier3.desc: Partial weekend coverage (Saturdays) extends operational days from 22 → 28 days/month
data.revenue_streams.tier3.revenue: Potential monthly revenue: ~3.84M BDT (at same occupancy)
data.revenue_streams.tier4.title: Tier 4 (Full Ecosystem)
data.revenue_streams.tier4.desc: Full weekend coverage + home care/online floaters enable ~30 effective days/month of service delivery
data.revenue_streams.tier4.revenue: Potential monthly revenue: ~4.11M BDT (at same occupancy)
data.revenue_streams.note: Note: Higher tier revenue calculations in the Capacity Modeler incorporate these expanded operational day models and service multipliers.
